label: WRONG
reason: Core's exported values are plain literals (auth.py AUTH_HEADER_PREFIXES, jwt.py token-type strings, search_tasks.py batch sizes, rlimit.py RLIMIT_TYPE), so 76/77 just reflects what constants are. There is no team-wide 'env only via settings' discipline to enforce: core reads os.environ directly in views.py home() and cleaners/html.py reload(), giftcard/models.py:108 reads DEFAULT_CURRENCY from env exactly like the outlier, and settings.py has no DEFAULT_CURRENCY; the outlier is the dev populatedb data script. No ruff rule in pyproject.toml covers it. Hesitated with ACCEPT, since routing new config through django settings is a defensible review point.
